title: Chapter 193
text:
This hidden main storyline seems to be related to unearthing history. Logically speaking, it shouldn't have much of an effect, but since it's a main storyline, will I be able to unearth some shocking secret?

Han Xiao thought to himself as he walked on the streets.

No matter what the secret was, it was his mission now, and he had plenty of opportunities to explore it. Of course, the most important thing was the reward.

The mission in Maple had been completed, so Han Xiao left on the same day. Threatening the officials in Maple had led to a secret manhunt by the intelligence agencies in the entire city. Since he had killed an official with a 'miraculous assassination technique', the manhunt was very intense.

Since they were from the same organization, Han Xiao left together with Golden Fox. Ghost Blade was reluctant at first, but the situation was dire, so he had no choice but to compromise.

However, Ghost Blade did not like the feeling of being protected by others. His mood became even more gloomy, and he gave off an oppressive aura.

After successfully leaving Maple, Han Xiao bade farewell to the two hesitant people and rushed to Fabian's transport plane without stopping. The players in the Western Continent's Novice Village were all waiting for him to show up. They could not wait to receive his favor, or rather, his presence!

The forums were in an uproar. The players who were waiting for Han Xiao were worried that Han Xiao would not come. They were all superstitious and started posting comments on the forums to pray for Han Xiao's arrival. There were even 300,000 comments. Han Xiao was worried that he would be drowned by the sea of people. It was really scary.

There were also players who were bored and started to joke.

"Young man, did you drop this Black Phantom, this White Phantom, or this Yellow Phantom? Hmm, you're an honest child. To reward you, pay up and learn a skill. "

"Shh, look, what did I find? There's a lone Black Phantom here. We can try to catch it. A Black Phantom can provide us with energy for a few days, but it's not easy to deal with. We have to approach it slowly from behind. Don't make any noise … Ah, I've been discovered. Help, it wants to eat me. Kevin, run! "

"Black Phantom used Death Stare on you. The effect is outstanding."

Finally, the Han Technician arrived at the third Novice Village in the Western Continent. There were a sea of players waiting for Han Xiao's arrival, more than any other Novice Village.

As soon as he appeared, players swarmed over like an avalanche. If one didn't know better, they would have thought that it was a plague of locusts.

Han Xiao looked at the level of the players. The average level was already LV 10. On the level ranking on the forums, the highest level was already LV 18. There were hundreds of people at the same level, and Maple Moon was one of them. With the help of the Great Mechanic Han, she was the biggest winner of the prize-pool mission.

However, the other players also had their own opportunities. There were many people of the same level, but most of them were foreign players from other novice planets. Blue Star was the default home of the Esports Clubs in China. However, they had the least number of players at the top of the Level Ranking Board. Han Xiao was very upset about this.

You guys are disappointing. Give me some strength ah!

However, he glanced at the sea of people in front of him, thought about it, and said righteously, "What's the use of leveling up fast? Being able to fight is the most important thing."

Yes, there was nothing wrong with that.

Other than the players from the big guilds who specialized in leveling up the Level Ranking Board, no one would do that. Leveling up fast at the beginning would get slower and slower as time went on.

Han Xiao had the EXP limit for issuing missions. If he wanted to train a player, he could make that player grow faster than everyone else. However, he wouldn't do that, at least not before the players reached LV 20.

Before LV 20, [Energy Training Method] was the most popular, and this was a huge profit.

…

As usual, he taught skills, and players swarmed over. Staying in the Novice Village to harvest EXP was also a form of relaxation for Han Xiao. He had time to browse the forums.

On the forums, the popularity of the Inhuman Phenomenon was through the roof. Not only on Blue Star, but also on other planets. The players were treated differently.

On the Magic Planet, they were studied by the wizards, and they were discovered to have excellent magic talent (learning ability on the player panel). They were actually able to join various magic academies.

On the Ancient Planet, they were considered to be messengers sent by the gods and were worshipped.

On Winterfrost Planet … Oh, Winterfrost Planet, the players were the safest. The Demon Race was not interested in their revival ability at all. When they saw the Void Demon Race's battleships traveling in the universe and using gravity traps to capture the asteroid belts around the planet to collect resources, everyone felt that the reaction of the Demon Race was normal.

The strength of the players was like a pile of ants to the Extinguish Army. Who would care about what an ant looked like?

Of course, it was also possible that the Demon Race was used to the revival ability. No one could be sure. After all, it was all guesswork.

The planets mentioned above were all very lucky, but Blue Star was one of the unluckiest planets. The NPCs were very afraid of the players, and the players were captured, studied, sliced, and brainwashed. This treatment was exactly the same as the old slaves in Africa!

It was inevitable that there would be complaints. Based on this and the situation of Blue Star, the players of Blue Star had a new guess.

Black Phantom was probably the game company's compensation to them!

"So that's why! That's why the other planets don't have people like Black Phantom. Only we do! "

"Luckily, we have Black Phantom. Otherwise, we would be dead meat!"

Seeing such comments, Han Xiao smiled. His efforts were not in vain …

Looking at the eyes of the players, his smile became even brighter. His expression was like an old farmer looking at his harvest.

Blue Star's Inhuman Phenomenon had reached a critical moment. All the major forces were contacting the players. Among them were the gentle ones like Stardragon and Hesla, the cold-blooded ones like Raylan and Ordina, and the other warlords and financial groups were also taking action. This was not without convenience. At least the players did not have to run around and had the opportunity to join a faction. This was indeed what the players did. Most of the players joined the Six Nations.

In Han Xiao's previous life, most of the players joined the Germinal Organization. Now that the Germinal Organization's bases were all destroyed, they could only stay in the main camp and capture the local players. It was miserable. Their numbers were 70 to 80 percent less than in Han Xiao's previous life.

The Inhuman Phenomenon also caused another change. The players became interested in teasing the NPCs and became curious babies who liked to ask questions. They also liked to do some outrageous things to see the NPCs' reactions.

The players were having fun, but in the eyes of the NPCs, their actions were extremely strange.

All the major forces wrote this slogan in the Inhuman Profile. "Inhumans are generally mentally ill. Their behavior is unpredictable. They can do anything. You can't understand them with normal thinking."

Han Xiao saw the slogans of these forces on the Dark Net and did not know whether to laugh or cry. There was another slogan that made him almost cramp up.

"After testing, Inhumans have genders, but they do not have genitals and reproductive abilities." The game did not allow players to strip naked. In the eyes of the NPCs, it was like their underwear had become a part of their body. This made them very confused. How could there be people who looked like that?

Han Xiao almost laughed himself crazy. He could already imagine how the various large organizations had discovered this …

Unable to reproduce, so the Inhumans could be ruled out as a new race. Of course, it could also be that the reproduction method was completely different from what Blue Star knew. There were also all kinds of speculations about the appearance of the Inhumans on the Dark Net.

Han Xiao realized that the long-abandoned religion seemed to be on the rise again. It said that the Inhumans were the messengers sent by God to save the world. Religion and superstition were always full of holes and could be linked to any phenomenon.

Some players had the idea of teasing Black Phantom. Since Black Phantom was a new guide, would he be like the other NPCs and have a strange reaction? Teasing NPCs was a very fun thing to do.

"Black Phantom, your name is Han Xiao. You used to serve in Stardragon and are now a member of the Dark Net. Am I right?" A player with the ID Flying Mantis Prawn suddenly said. He had seen the video of Bun-hit-dog beating up Bun-hit-dog, and he had an idea. He wanted to see what would happen if he exposed Bun-hit-dog's identity in front of Black Phantom.

Black Phantom would not know that his identity was exposed. When he saw a stranger expose his identity, would Black Phantom lose his composure and be shocked?
